phenotype_standardization: mean0/std1 after QTN + polygenic + residual combination
rice_qtn_sampling: draw n_qtn candidates per chromosome, then globally choose n_qtn from their union
cotton_qtn_sampling: globally choose n_qtn from qualified scored loci in grouped chromosome order
frozen_locus_universe_scope: Conditional benchmark on real-run selected SNP maps, not an all-variant QTN or GWAS comparison.
software_note: Eigenvector-based phenotype draws may require the original NumPy/BLAS runtime; verify actual outputs, never replace observations to force parity.
